name: caller-tool-call-ends-run-as-pending-effect
description: A call naming a caller tool is a terminal answer addressed to the caller, riding the same pending-effect seam a held approval rides: the run ends AwaitingInput and the call itself travels out on the session, so a different process can hand the caller the act rather than only the news that something is waiting.

callerTools.name: send_email
callerTools.description: Sends an email from the caller's own outbox.
